import statistics

    -4180,   # 1955
    1626,    # 1956
    1596,    # 1957
    -2819,   # 1958
    -12427   # 1959
]

# Calculate sample standard deviation (n-1 denominator)
sample_std = statistics.stdev(values)

print("Values (FY 1945-1959):", values)
print("Number of years:", len(values))
print("Mean:", statistics.mean(values))
print("Sample standard deviation:", sample_std)
print("Rounded to 3 decimal places (in millions):", round(sample_std, 3))

arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Fiscal year surplus/deficit data from the treasury bulletins (in millions)
# FY 1945-1959
values = [
    -53941,  # 1945
    -20676,  # 1946
    754,     # 1947
    8419,    # 1948
    -1811,   # 1949
    -3122,   # 1950
    3510,    # 1951
    -4017,   # 1952
    -9449,   # 1953
    -3117,   # 1954
    -4180,   # 1955
    1626,    # 1956
    1596,    # 1957
    -2819,   # 1958
    -12427   # 1959
]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation using the formula
# s = sqrt(Σ(xi - x̄)² / (n-1))
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
print(f"Sum of squared diffs: {sum(squared_diffs)}")

sample_variance = sum(squared_diffs) / (n - 1)
print(f"Sample variance: {sample_variance}")

sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f"Sample standard deviation: {sample_std}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(sample_std, 3)}")
EOF
